headline: Torrential Tribute
title: Torrential Tribute Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Torrential Tribute. What is it? It is a Normal Trap Card. What does it do? When a monster is Summoned, destroy all monsters on the field. How do you use it? Set it when your field is empty, and let your opponent walk into it. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
